scripts.deploy:availability: cd api/getAvailability && npm install --production && mkdir -p ../dist && zip -r ../dist/get-availability.zip . && cd ../.. && aws lambda update-function-code --function-name chevrotain-get-availability --zip-file fileb://api/dist/get-availability.zip --region eu-north-1
scripts.deploy:booking: cd api/createBooking && npm install --production && mkdir -p ../dist && zip -r ../dist/create-booking.zip . && cd ../.. && aws lambda update-function-code --function-name chevrotain-create-booking --zip-file fileb://api/dist/create-booking.zip --region eu-north-1
scripts.deploy:lambdas: npm run deploy:availability && npm run deploy:booking
